howToRead: A word can match several endings — the LONGEST one wins (it is the most specific). 'Nation' matches -ion and -tion -> use -tion (die, 99.8%); 'Biologie' matches -e and -ie -> use -ie (die, 97%). Each ending's `overriddenBy` lists the more-specific endings that beat it, so overlapping endings (-ion/-tion/-sion, -e/-ie, -eit/-heit/-keit) can be shown together as a family rather than scattered.
scope: MORPHOLOGICAL rules only: word-ending (suffix) rules + the compound-head rule. This file does NOT contain the app's THEMATIC/semantic rules (e.g. car brands -> der, days/months/seasons -> der, male people & animals -> der, weather -> der). Those are a separate rule type the app defines on its own and MUST be left untouched — these suffix-based rules are meant to sit alongside them, not replace them.
source: german-nouns lexicon (~93k nouns, Wiktionary); refined by morphological rules. Compound-head split uses a frequency floor (wordfreq 3.1.1).

der.note: → der (Baum, Raum, Traum). Virtually no exceptions.
→ der (Arzt and its compounds: Facharzt, Zahnarzt).
Agent nouns → der (Journalist). The -frist family (die) is split off into its own rule.
French agent nouns → der (Friseur, Ingenieur, Masseur).
Agent nouns → der (Student). The neuter -ment family is split off; das Talent/Patent remain rare exceptions.
→ der (Honig, König). Cardinal numbers (-zig/-ßig) are split off; das Reisig is an exception.
Diminutive/agent → der (Frühling, Lehrling). Borrowed English -ing gerunds (Bowling, Styling) are das and remain exceptions.
→ der (Staat, Bundesstaat). die Saat is an exception.
Agent nouns → der (Demonstrant). das Restaurant / Quant compounds and French loans are exceptions.
→ der (Aktionär, Millionär, Sekretär). das Quartär is an exception.
→ der (Teppich). Exceptions are compounds of das Reich (Königreich, Tierreich).
→ der (Doktor, Motor, Professor). das Labor / das Tor are exceptions.
Agent nouns → der (Lehrer, Bäcker). Big group; common exceptions: die Mutter/Schwester, das Fenster/Wasser.
Leans der (Punkt, Markt, Akt) — but Latin neuters das Produkt/Objekt/Projekt are a big exception group.

die.note: Latin -tät → die (Universität, Qualität). No exceptions.
die Frist and all its compounds (Kündigungsfrist, Anmeldefrist) → die.
Abstract nouns → die (Möglichkeit). Very reliable.
→ die (Nation, Information). One of the most reliable rules.
Female agent suffix → die (Lehrerin, Schülerin, Sportlerin). Effectively always die.
→ die (Zeitung, Meinung). A handful of masculine exceptions (der Ursprung, der Schwung).
→ die (Freundschaft, Wissenschaft). Very reliable.
Abstract nouns → die (Freiheit, Schönheit). Very reliable.
→ die (Explosion, Diskussion). Reliable; a few Greek neuters (das Symposion) are exceptions.
→ die (Natur, Kultur, Literatur, Architektur). Very reliable.
→ die (97%): academic topics (Biologie, Philosophie, Chemie) and most -ie words. Exceptions are loanwords (der Junkie, das Cookie) and das Knie / Genie.
→ die (Ankunft, Auskunft, Vernunft, Zukunft).
French loan suffix → die (Garage, Etage, Massage); also native -lage/-frage (Anlage). das Gelage / Image are exceptions.
French loan suffix → die (Marmelade, Parade, Fassade). der Nomade and English loans (das Upgrade) are exceptions.
→ die (Musik, Politik, Physik, Technik).
Latin abstract suffix → die (Distanz, Toleranz, Tendenz, Konferenz). Native der Tanz/Kranz/Glanz are exceptions.
→ die (Zeit, Arbeit, Mahlzeit). der Streit is the main exception. (-heit/-keit are their own rules.)
→ die (Sonne, Blume, Lampe). Huge group; exceptions are masculine n-stems (der Junge, der Name) and das Auge/Ende.
Activity/place nouns → die (Bäckerei, Polizei, Partei). der Brei / das Allerlei are exceptions.
Cardinal-number suffix → die (die Zwanzig, die Dreißig).
→ die (Figur, Tour, Spur). -tur (Natur/Kultur) and -eur (der Friseur) split off; musical keys (der C-Dur) and der Schwur remain.
Female agents are die (Königin, Ärztin), but as a bare ending it's mixed: der Termin, das Benzin. The reliable part is -erin.
ALONE, this is barely a coin flip (~59%): der Champion / Spion / Anion. Trust -tion and -sion, NOT bare -ion.

das.note: Latin neuter → das (Stadium, Studium). Effectively no exceptions.
Diminutive → das (Mädchen). Exceptions are compounds of der Kuchen / der Knochen — not real diminutives.
Latin -mentum → das (Dokument, Element). Distinct from the masculine -ent agent suffix.
→ das (System, Problem, Morphem). der Atem is an exception.
→ das (Wachstum, Eigentum, Christentum). der Reichtum / Irrtum are exceptions.
→ das (Museum, Datum, Zentrum). -aum (der Baum) and -tum are split off; der Konsum is an exception.
→ das (Material, Potenzial, Editorial, Adverbial). A few obscure der exceptions (Labial).
Leans das (Ergebnis, Verständnis, Zeugnis) — but die Erlaubnis/Kenntnis/Finsternis are common.
Leans das (Paket, Gebet, Gebiet) — but der Planet/Komet/Prophet are exceptions.
Leans das (Brot, Gebot, Angebot) — but die Not and der Pilot/Idiot are exceptions.
Greek -ma leans das (Thema, Drama, Klima, Komma). die Firma is the main exception.
Leans das (~56%): das Auto, Büro, Kino, Video — but der Tango/Kakao and die Disco are common. The weakest rule; many -o words are best memorised.

compoundRule.note: A compound takes the gender of its LAST noun: das Werk+Zeug, die Auto+Bahn, der Apfel+Kuchen. When in doubt about a long word, look at its final part.
